beginner.title: Get started with AgriWebb
beginner.outcome: You can: set up AgriWebb, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up for your situation
beginner.outcome: You can: configure AgriWebb for your farm, site or community
beginner.practice: Set up your locations and units

beginner.title: Record in the field
beginner.outcome: You can: record quickly and accurately
beginner.practice: Record five observations in the field

intermediate.title: Use the insights
intermediate.outcome: You can: turn records into decisions
intermediate.practice: Act on one insight from AgriWebb

intermediate.title: Share and collaborate
intermediate.outcome: You can: share data with your team or advisers
intermediate.practice: Share a report with an adviser or buyer

intermediate.title: Signature skills in AgriWebb
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make AgriWebb distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced AgriWebb
expert.outcome: You can: use AgriWebb's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Data you can trust
expert.outcome: You can: keep good records over seasons

expert.title: Integrate AgriWebb into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect AgriWebb with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect AgriWebb to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use AgriWebb well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use AgriWebb" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
